standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of relative Proj with base change of the graded algebra, cited from the constructions chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Lets the statement be checked over a finitely generated model ring and then transported back.

standard_prerequisites.name: The relative Proj of a finitely generated graded algebra is of finite type and its twists are quasi-coherent modules of finite type, cited from the same chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives finite type for the model, which is upgraded to finite presentation over a Noetherian base.

standard_prerequisites.name: A finite type morphism of Noetherian schemes is of finite presentation, and a coherent module over a Noetherian scheme is of finite presentation, cited from the morphisms chapter and the cohomology of schemes chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades finite type to finite presentation for both the morphism and the twists over the Noetherian model.

core_obligations: Reduce to an algebraic statement: locally on the base the claim becomes the statement that for a finitely presented graded algebra over a ring the relative Proj is of finite presentation and its twists are finitely presented modules (proof lines 7855-7860).

Write a presentation of the algebra: finite presentation gives a presentation of the graded algebra as a quotient of a weighted polynomial ring by finitely many homogeneous polynomials (proof lines 7861-7866).

Pass to a finitely generated model: let the subring of the coefficients of those polynomials be the model ring, form the same quotient over it, and observe that the original algebra is obtained by base change; by compatibility of relative Proj with base change it suffices to prove the claim over the model (proof lines 7866-7872).

Finish over the Noetherian model: the model ring is a finitely generated ring hence Noetherian, the relative Proj over it is of finite type with twists of finite type, and over a Noetherian base finite type morphisms and coherent modules are of finite presentation, which gives the claim and hence the original statement (proof lines 7873-7886).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a graded presentation over a ring (proof lines 7855-7866).

Keep only the coefficients of the defining polynomials, prove the claim over that finitely generated (hence Noetherian) ring using finite type plus the Noetherian upgrade, and transport back by base change (proof lines 7866-7886).
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a finitely presented quasi-coherent graded algebra the relative Proj is a morphism of finite presentation and its twists are finitely presented modules (statement lines 7845-7853). The counted proof is a clean reduction: affine locally it writes a graded presentation of the algebra, replaces the base ring by the finitely generated subring generated by the coefficients of the defining polynomials, uses compatibility of relative Proj with base change to reduce to that Noetherian model, applies the finite type statement for relative Proj there, and upgrades finite type to finite presentation using that the model is Noetherian (proof lines 7855-7886). It is H2: the reduction and both upgrades are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being standard base change and Noetherian finiteness statements.
